name: Temecula Promenade
description: Temecula Promenade is a vibrant open-air shopping center located on Winchester Road in the heart of Temecula wine country. This community-focused destination features a diverse mix of national retailers, local boutiques, restaurants, and service providers. Conveniently positioned along a major thoroughfare, the Promenade serves the growing Temecula Valley with accessible shopping and dining options.
summary: Temecula Promenade is an open-air community shopping center featuring diverse retail, dining, and services along Winchester Road in Temecula's wine country.
